arguments.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"node -e 'const fs=require(\"fs\"); const rows=fs.readFileSync(\"/app/input/events.jsonl\",\"utf8\").trimEnd().split(\"\\n\").filter(Boolean).map(JSON.parse); const ds=rows.map(x=>x.duration_ms).sort((a,b)=>a-b); const counts=Object.fromEntries([...rows.reduce((m,x)=>m.set(x.kind,(m.get(x.kind)||0)+1),new Map()).entries()].sort(([a],[b])=>a.localeCompare(b))); console.log(JSON.stringify({schema_version:1,total_events:rows.length,counts,total_duration_ms:ds.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),p95_duration_ms:ds[Math.ceil(.95*ds.length)-1]},null,2))'","workdir":"/app","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000});
text(r.output);
